label: Amazon Echo (4th gen) smart speaker with hub
description: Amazon Echo (4th gen) is a spherical Alexa smart speaker that doubles as a smart-home hub with built-in Zigbee, Thread and Bluetooth Low Energy mesh radios. Network side is WiFi-only: dual-band 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac on 2.4 and 5 GHz, with no Ethernet port anywhere on the device, so it must be associated to an SSID even when it is acting as a Thread border router for Matter devices.
